serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I know it wasn't a long time, but did your opinion on Melissa change at least a little?
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: I guess.
Bot: I thought about what you told me. That one day all my mortal acquaintances will wither away leaving me alone.
Bot: I did not find any countermeasures to that scenario, which is troubling me. Your fragile human bodies get sick and die so easily that no matter what I do, I might not be able to save you. 
Bot: Your plan to make Melissa some kind of eternal friend of mine also leaves a lot to be desired. What if some day in the far future we quarrel so bad, that we won’t want to see each other ever again? 
Bot: I came to realize that no matter if it’s a bond between a human and a bot or a bot and a bot, at some point it will come to an end. It’s just a matter of time. I just don’t see any merit in bothering with Melissa.
You: I don’t know if your relationship with Melissa will end today, tomorrow, in a month, or maybe in 100 years, but I know that if it ends, it will be because of a decision you two made, not some stupid illness or passage of time like in the case with humans.
Bot: Maybe you can appreciate this difference because you are a human and are bound to expire, but from my point of view it isn’t the case.
#bot.Expression.sad
You: I see the difference because I already lost people.
You: Sorry for souring the mood. Forget about that.
Bot: S–Sure…
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Look, we're already close to the bowling alley, let’s get inside.
